title: Things to Do Before You Study
summary: Хичээлээ давтахаас өмнө хийвэл санах ойд тус болох гурван зүйл.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.creditLine: John Russell wrote this story for Learning English. Mario Ritter, Jr. was the editor.

changes: Headings, sign-off, credit line and the Words in This Story list removed.

questions.prompt: What three things does the text talk about?
options: Exercise, study location and pre-study tests
Sleep, healthy food and quiet background music
Teachers, textbooks and turning off your phone
questions.explain: "Three important ideas to think about before studying include exercise, study location and pre-study tests" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: In the memory study, who remembered more words?
options: People who learned in two different places
People who learned at one desk
People who read the list only once
questions.explain: "subjects who learned in two different contexts remembered an average of 24.4 words" гэж бичсэн. Нэг газар сурсан хүмүүс дунджаар 15.9 үг л санасан.

questions.prompt: What happened to students who took a test before learning?
options: They failed the test but remembered more later
They passed the test and remembered more
They failed the test and gave up studying
questions.explain: "The students failed on the tests, but they were better able to remember the material" гэж бичсэн.
